steps.en: Install the package (or load the browser bundle)
steps.zh: 安装 npm 包（或在浏览器加载打包文件）

steps.en: Create a parser and hand it the Markdown string
steps.zh: 创建解析器，把 Markdown 字符串交给它

steps.en: Builds blocks first, then inline elements, into a node tree per the spec
steps.zh: 按规范先建块、再解析行内元素，生成节点树

steps.en: Walk the tree and rewrite the nodes you care about
steps.zh: 遍历这棵树，改写你关心的节点

steps.en: Render with a renderer, turning on safe mode for untrusted input
steps.zh: 用渲染器输出，不受信任的输入要开安全模式

steps.en: Emits spec-exact HTML, replacing raw HTML and unsafe URLs when safe is on
steps.zh: 输出严格合规的 HTML，开安全模式时替换原始 HTML 和危险链接

value.en: Markdown interpreted exactly as the CommonMark spec says, with a tree you can edit before it becomes HTML
value.zh: 严格按 CommonMark 规范理解 Markdown，并在变成 HTML 之前给你一棵可改的树

sources: README.md @ 2026-10-08 'Installing': 'npm install commonmark', dist/ browser bundles
